text_block_list.text: After going out with Grass Wonder—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, take a look~.
The sunset reflecting on the river is so pretty—
(—*plop!*)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Just now in the river, was there something...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, I'm pretty sure it was a scene like this!
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Taiki-senpai? What are you doing~?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Grass! There's something I just
can't seem to remember! It's bugging me so much~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Something you can't remember...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It's a Japanese poem I learned in class!
A frog plops into water, or something like that—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Well, what I just threw wasn't a frog,
but a stone! Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"The old pond / A frog jumps in / The sound of water"—
would it be something like that~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~?
Maybe it was that, or maybe it wasn't...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Me no understand difficult Japanese!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My, oh my~...
choice_data_list: Why don't you try teaching her in English?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Sensei taught me
what it meant in English too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“—Meaning, uhm.
If I remember correctly...”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
『Old pond
frogs jumped in
sound of water』――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's it!
That's the one, Graaass!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It's a beautiful poem!
This is what Grass calls 'wabi-sabi', yes!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes. It really is a beautiful English translation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It carries the earnest wish to convey the charm and rhythm
of haiku even to people overseas—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees! So splendid!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That cleared away all the gloom~!
Thank you, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Aha. Grass speaks great Japanese and English, she's a true 'Yamato Nadeshiko' girl~!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then! I shall go on a search
for the Jumping Frog~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No more throwing rocks into the river now~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Taiki-senpai is as energetic as ever~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Still.
'Nadeshiko Girl', is it?"
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll call you that from now on.
We managed to bridge Japan and America.
We managed to bridge Japan and America.
"Nadeshiko Girl"—I like the sound of that.
"Nadeshiko Girl" is a nice phrase, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Still.
'Nadeshiko Girl', is it?"
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll call you that from now on.
We managed to bridge Japan and America.
We managed to bridge Japan and America.
"Nadeshiko Girl"—I like the sound of that.
"Nadeshiko Girl" is a nice phrase, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...My.
That's a bit embarrassing to hear~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, shall I call you
'Samurai Trainer,' Trainer-san?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Right? Come on, let's head back now,
Samurai Trainer♪

Asking her to please stop calling me that,
I walked back to the academy with Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu.
Somehow, I feel truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because I was able to connect two things I love so much,
with my very own hands like this.
choice_data_list: Tell me more about America again!
Tell me more about America again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, gladly. Leave it to
the 'Nadeshiko Girl', Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I want you to know all about
my hometown, Trainer~♪

After that, Grass Wonder and I
headed home while talking about America.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Yes, I like it very much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Not just a traditional Yamato Nadeshiko.
For someone caught between worlds like me, it's the perfect term."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'd be so happy if people called me that in a race someday~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not just in Japan, but across America as well.
Resonating the name of Grass Wonder, the "Nadeshiko Girl,"
across both of her home countries—
choice_data_list: We will definitely make that dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
I trust you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Japan and America. Myself and Trainer.
Without both parts together, it's something we could never achieve—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"A single thread cannot make a rope."
I believe there are things that can only be achieved because I'm with you♪

It was a day that renewed my resolve
to seize the top alongside Grass Wonder.
